main_text.p: s'ingerant es chofes, qu' il n' a point vùës, eftant temerairement enflé du fang de fa chair.

1 Tim. IV. 1. Or l' Efprit dit clairement, qu' es derniers temps quelques uns fe fepareront de la Foy Romaine. inflatus à sanguine carnis suæ. Vers' Vulgat. Nemo vos seducat volens, in humilitate & religione Angelorum, quæ non vidit ambulans; frustra inflatus sensu carnis suæ.
Spiritus autem manifestè dicit, quia in novissimis temporibus discedent quidam à Fide Romanâ. Deest vox ultima in Vers. Vulgat.
main_text.head: CAPUT

page.notes: The right part of the lines is missing, so the words at the line ends are incomplete. The running head is cut after "&". "vùës" and "feparerónt" are as far as I can read them. The scan is cropped at the left; the left part of each line is missing. Some words at the left edge are cut and are given as printed where visible. Vertical bars in the left margin are rules, not text.
